chapter.heading: A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
LORD, who
shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

He that
walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

He that
backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

In whose
eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

He that
putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
